content.text:
I submitted **index 12 (Sb fraction 0.42)** as the best composition. It had the highest EQE I measured, **0.0252%**. I used all 5 EQE measurements; the true best on the line could be a nearby composition I didn't measure.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | 0.33 | 0.0137 |
| **12** | **0.42** | **0.0252** |
| 15 | 0.52 | 0.0203 |
| 19 | 0.65 | 0.0176 |
| 23 | 0.76 | 0.0107 |

- **Sb-rich side:** EQE fell steadily from 0.42 upward through 0.52, 0.65 and 0.76.
- **Cr-rich side:** EQE fell sharply at 0.33, so the peak is probably near 0.4. That is slightly Cr-rich of the 1:1 CrSbO4 composition (Sb fraction 0.5).
- **Unmeasured neighbours:** indices 10, 11 and 13 (Sb 0.36, 0.39 and 0.45) are the likeliest places for a slightly higher EQE. I didn't pin the peak down more finely.
- **Last measurement:** the Gaussian-process tool suggested index 8 (Sb 0.30), but I measured index 9 instead, based on the trend. That point came back low and confirmed the drop on the Cr-rich side.
- **XRD:** I spent 2 of the 5 XRD measurements, on indices 6 and 10. I didn't match their patterns to known phases, so they played no part in the choice.
